svg.text: Call flow 2 of 3 — the two perception paths reaching one store
Both sources arrive on their own thread, are parsed into the same frozen object, and meet at a single writer.
The store is the sole writer of a track's state. A detector line or a relayed object arrives carrying not_tracked by convention and that value is discarded, so nothing outside the
store can claim a track is confirmed.
Neither namespace can be minted by the other side: the detector cannot produce a v2x: id and the relay cannot produce an own: id. That is what makes the zero-C claim structural
R3 JSONL line — own_sensor, id own:n
malformed body: parse_reject, counted by reason, never fatal
